title: Physical road flow; excludes virtual movement arcs; static model PCE, not counts
caption: Saved physical-link PCE for 08:00–09:00 HBW. Only physical road geometry is drawn; virtual movement arcs are excluded. Color is log(1 + PCE), with the legend labelled in PCE per period. OpenStreetMap contributors, ODbL 1.0. Model output, not observed traffic. Each directed segment retains its own flow; serial segments from a shared source way are not summed. The scope is the 5-zone Jane Byrne/West Loop subarea. Single-pass engineering scenario; no local empirical calibration.
